meta.canonical_variant: Single neonatal specimen, segmented blood pool with a myocardial surface

provenance.creator: 3D Heart Project (University of Alberta / Stollery Children's Hospital)

modified.note: Ingested by pipeline/ingest.py: structures split and labelled, pose normalised, decimated for interactive display, exported to glTF, and voxelised to a labelled echo volume at 192^3. No geometry was added, sculpted, or invented. ORIENTATION UNVERIFIED. This source carries no chamber labels, so anterior and patient-left cannot be derived from the geometry. The declared convention is the glTF default (+y up) with the remaining axes unconfirmed, and must be set at vetting before any clinical use. REJECTED AS SUBSTRATE (2026-08-19). The blood pool and the myocardium interpenetrate rather than nesting: they are not a cast-and-shell pair, so wall thickness cannot be derived by pairing them. Extents differ sharply (84.5 mm against 43.5 mm on the superior axis, the blood pool running up the great vessels where no myocardium exists), only about a third of the blood-pool surface lies inside the myocardium, and the pairwise distance spreads from 0.05 to 33.9 mm. NOT PUBLISHED, and independently licence-blocked: the site-wide CC BY-NC claim and the per-model CC BY 4.0 grant are unreconciled. Retained in the repository as evidence. Renders in an UNVERIFIED orientation. LICENCE CONFLICT, resolved by owner decision (2026-08-18): 3dheartproject.com states a site-wide CC BY-NC grant while the per-model Sketchfab grant AND the license.txt inside the download both read CC BY 4.0. The owner elected the CC BY 4.0 reading. The conflict itself is recorded in the pack's provenance rather than hidden, so the decision is auditable and reversible if written confirmation contradicts it.
